scope: Common W02 M1-M4 Fresh Exact AC sensitivity-key recovery, R24 numerical refinement and clean R3 restart

root_cause.description: The recovery cut iterated voltage rows whose keys were not guaranteed to exist in every finite-difference OpenDSS sample, then accessed the gradient map with an unguarded subscript. M1, M2 and M4 therefore stopped on the same KeyError before the bounded recovery state machine could finish.

corrections: Build sensitivities only for voltage keys that are hard violations in the authoritative initial Fresh OpenDSS result.
Require each target voltage key to be present in the baseline and every finite-difference sample before forming a gradient.

Use guarded gradient lookup during cut assembly; each incomplete P or Q coordinate is fixed at its accepted base value before a zero coefficient is used, so the recovery feasible set is restricted rather than expanded.
Collect every feasible positive and negative finite-difference direction at the selected step rather than retaining only the last direction.
When and only when an otherwise accepted solution exceeds the frozen R24 numerical residual gate, re-optimize the same primary objective once with strict numerical settings; never relax the gate.
Do not relax voltage, P=550 kW, S=700 kVA, Fresh Exact OpenDSS, or no-future-actual constraints.

r1_forensic_disposition.reason: R1 contains committed prefixes produced by the pre-correction runner and must not be mixed with the corrected runner SHA.

r2_forensic_disposition.reason: R2 is source-bound to the prior runner SHA and cannot be mixed with the R3 recovery hardening.
